I don't have the authority to offer compensation or make commitments on liability, so I don't want to guess at something here. Let me get our events manager to confirm that for you — they'll email you today so you can discuss what happened and figure out next steps directly with them.

Can I pass along your event date and name now so they have the details ready when they reach out?
